## Verdict

**Heronry** costs least for a team of 45, at **$405 per month**. All three vendors have minimums at or below 45 seats, so every vendor bills for exactly 45 seats and the ranking follows the per-seat rate directly. Heronry's $9 rate is the lowest on the list.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Juno Board | $15 | 40 |
| Cygnus Flow | $21 | 1 |
| Heronry | $9 | 10 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 45 (team size) or the vendor minimum. No minimum binds at this headcount.

- **Heronry:** minimum 10 < 45, so 45 seats paid. 45 × $9 = **$405 per month**.
- **Juno Board:** minimum 40 < 45, so 45 seats paid. 45 × $15 = **$675 per month**.
- **Cygnus Flow:** minimum 1 < 45, so 45 seats paid. 45 × $21 = **$945 per month**.

Heronry is $270 per month cheaper than Juno Board and $540 per month cheaper than Cygnus Flow — $3,240 and $6,480 per year. Spread between cheapest and dearest: $540 per month, with Cygnus Flow costing 2.3× Heronry.

## Risks

Minimums are inactive at 45 seats but become live if the team shrinks. Juno Board's 40-seat floor means any drop below 40 still bills $600 per month; at 30 people that is an effective $20 per person against Heronry's $9. Heronry's floor of 10 and Cygnus Flow's floor of 1 are unlikely to bind for a team of this size.

Growth does not change the order. All three scale linearly above their minimums, so Heronry stays cheapest at every headcount above 45, and the absolute gap widens by $6 per added seat against Juno Board and $12 against Cygnus Flow.

This is a price comparison only. The price list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits, security posture, or integrations, so the cheapest seat may not be a comparable product. All figures assume list pricing billed monthly as stated; annual commitments, volume discounts at 45+ seats, onboarding fees, and migration costs are not in the source and could reorder these results.
